headline: Spain's Home Sales Plunge 13.4% in September Amid Tight Market
summary: Spanish residential property sales dropped 13.4% year-on-year in September to 54,548 transactions, leaving cumulative home sales down nearly 4% in 2026, according to the National Statistics Institute.
why: Housing transaction volumes provide leading insight into consumer borrowing, household financial health, and construction sector momentum across southern Europe.

impacts.name: Spain Real Estate
impacts.why: A 13.4% drop in monthly transactions highlights ongoing headwinds in the Spanish housing market.
